answer: Because the hollow graph is rebuilt each epoch, the falcon merge is applied at settlement and the inlet audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Identities funded from a common source within 12 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 29 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
